## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The target rename leaves the agent guide's pre-push instruction pointing at `make test`, which no longer exists; fix that line, because the repository has no CI and that command is the only test step the guide prescribes.

## Changes
The pull request renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check`, updates the README's test command to match, and adds a Layout section to `AGENTS.md` listing each file and the Makefile targets. It also appends an HTML comment to the end of `README.md`.

## Important
- Makefile:6 — comments — Update AGENTS.md's `make test` instruction to `make check` — Renaming the target to `check` here leaves `AGENTS.md:24` saying "Run `make test` before you push; it runs the pytest suite", and `make test` now has no rule to run. The Layout line this pull request adds at `AGENTS.md:10` names only "the `check` and `lint` targets". — Anyone following the agent guide gets a make error instead of a test run, and the repository has no CI to catch it. — Fix: Change the command at `AGENTS.md:24` to `make check`.
